basis_words: GET 1 (kind newportfolio_active: the pull's own NewPortfolio request with isActive true) returned HTTP 200 with 3040 account rows. The account id key is the row field id, the only id-like field in the rows; the known present account is found under it. All three roles were found in that one body: missing, series_less and present. Because the missing account was found in GET 1, GET 2 (isActive false) and GET 3 (the base roster) were not made; the cap of three was not reached and no retry was made. Pace: one GET, so no interval applies, and no non-2xx. Credential: the estate loader returned a token and the GET was 2xx, so the verdict is ACCEPTED. Missing versus present: 7 fields differ; the relevant ones are accountStartDate, accountStartValue and modelName; none is exclusion-type, so the verdict is STATUS_OR_DATE_DIFFERS, and no relevant differing field is a boolean on either record (bool_values is empty). Series-less versus present: 18 fields differ; the same three relevant names; no exclusion-type name; the same verdict; no boolean. Does a flag explain the omission: not in any field compared, because no exclusion-type or inclusion field differs between the missing account and the present one and no relevant boolean differs. What the records did not show: fields the name patterns do not match, anything Scope itself consults, and the cause of the omission. The missing account is listed in Orion's active whole-firm account list, so the omission sits in Scope, not in the account list. Reads: the round-118 record, the private dimension and the flag-false Q3 body were read locally; no S3 read, no AWS write, one token load.
